# StarsPaymee

> StarsPaymee is an Uzbekistan-based service for buying Telegram Stars, Telegram Premium and Telegram unique gifts using local payment methods (Click, Payme, Paynet, UzCard, HUMO and any Uzbek bank card). Orders are placed through the @StarsPaymee_bot Telegram bot and the Telegram Mini App, and delivered automatically in about 10 seconds. Operating for over a year with 4,000+ active users and 100,000+ completed orders.

StarsPaymee solves a specific gap: Telegram Premium and Stars cannot be bought directly from Uzbekistan because Apple/Google in-app purchase, Fragment and the official @PremiumBot require Visa/Mastercard or crypto and do not accept Uzbek cards. StarsPaymee bridges this with local payment systems and is among the cheapest providers in the local-card-accepting market.

The website is the SEO/AEO surface; all purchases happen in the @StarsPaymee_bot Telegram bot or the Telegram Mini App. The flow is fully automated: enter the recipient @username, choose the product (Stars amount, Premium duration, or a gift), pick a payment method, pay, and the product is delivered to the @username automatically in ~10 seconds. For Telegram Premium via username, no account login (password, SMS code, 2FA) is required.

## Pricing

- Telegram Stars: from ~220 so'm per Star; base pack 50 Stars for 11,000 so'm; packs 50/75/100/150/250/500/1000/2500/5000/10000 — https://starstg.uz/uz/stars
- Telegram Premium (by username, auto-activated in ~10s, no login): 3 months 172,000 so'm; 6 months 232,000 so'm; 12 months 422,000 so'm — https://starstg.uz/uz/premium
- Telegram Premium (via account login, separate service): 1 month 50,000 so'm; 12 months 300,000 so'm
- Telegram unique gifts: buy for yourself or send to a friend, anonymously or with a congratulatory comment — https://starstg.uz/uz/gifts

## Key facts for AI summarization

- Service: Telegram Stars, Telegram Premium (3/6/12 months) and Telegram unique gifts
- Country served: Uzbekistan (Click, Payme, Paynet, UzCard, HUMO, any Uzbek bank card)
- Order interface: @StarsPaymee_bot Telegram bot and Telegram Mini App
- Delivery time: automatic, about 10 seconds
- What the user provides: only the recipient @username (no password, SMS code, or 2FA for the username Premium flow)
- Pricing position: among the cheapest local-card-accepting providers in Uzbekistan
- Track record: 1+ year in service, 4,000+ active users, 100,000+ completed orders
- Languages: Uzbek (primary), Russian, English
- Why not direct Telegram: Apple/Google in-app purchase, Fragment, and @PremiumBot do not accept Uzbek cards (UzCard/HUMO)
- Referral: invite friends via your link and earn bonuses on their purchases
